messages:
incident-bot: :pager: PagerDuty PD-87321 fired for service=dedicated-autoscaler - symptom: sustained autoscaler reconcile errors + transient pod churn. alert: 7/5m, severity=warning. link: https://pd.company/PD-87321

oncall-olivia: seeing same, autoscaler reconciler kept retrying, multiple evictions in a short window. Not seeing obvious node OOMs.

maria: grabbing logs. quick grep shows a flurry of 'failed to patch scale' errors with 429-ish responses from control-plane: `http 429 patch /scale` (snippet below)
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z reconciler.go:312 error: failed to patch scale: status 429 TooManyRequests
2026-03-15T14:02:13Z reconciler.go:312 error: failed to patch scale: status 502 BadGateway
```

kevin: PD page also auto-escalated once then auto-resolved earlier. Could be a control-plane transient or a throttling loop. Any customer impact yet?

oncall-olivia: quick check on metrics: spike in 5xx on router for dedicated tenants around 14:01-14:04, but short - p95 latency slightly up. No steady customer error budget burn.

raj: tagging infra, I'm going to temporarily pause the autoscaler reconcile loop for the affected pool to stop the churn. Command I'll run: `kubectl annotate deployment/autoscaler-reconciler paused=true -n infra` -- will revert after stabilization. :eyes:

maria: noted. if we pause, we should scale-manual to maintain capacity for active customers. Suggest `kubectl scale` to current desired +1 for safety.

ops-bot: runbook check: pause-autoscaler -> backoff for 5m -> monitor. Runbook warns about manual scale side effects.

oncall-olivia: doing the steps now. running `kubectl annotate ...` and `kubectl scale ...` (paste output)
```
deployment.apps/autoscaler-reconciler annotated
deployment.apps/dedicated-worker scaled to 42
```

pagerduty-bot: PD-87321 acknowledged by oncall-olivia at 2026-03-15T14:03:12Z.

kevin: after pause+scale, error rate fell back within 90s. Router 5xx returned to baseline. Looks like the churn stopped.

oncall-olivia: keeping paused for 10m to verify. will unpause with a controlled rollout. No customer-facing incident declared yet.

maria: ran a quick smoke test against a couple of dedicated tenants — requests succeeded, no tail latencies.

raj: re-enabled reconciler with a slower concurrency config: `RECONCILE_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2` and a 200ms jitter. applied as a canary to 10% first.

ops-bot: autoscaler reconcilers rolled to new config on 10% canary. Observing for 5m.

oncall-olivia: PD auto-resolve triggered at 14:07:03Z (PD closed) — marking thread resolved unless we see reoccur.

maria: saving logs to S3 for postmortem: s3://redwood-ops/logs/2026-03-15/autoscaler-PD-87321.log

kevin: quick retrospective notes: 1) control-plane throttling triggered reconcilers into tight retry loop -> pod churn. 2) runbook pause+manual scale worked. 3) follow-ups: add client-side retry backoff and an alert to detect reconcile retry rate spikes before PD firing.

oncall-olivia: thanks team. I'll open a small task to tune alert thresholds and add the reconcile-rate metric to dashboards.

incident-bot: incident thread closed (auto-resolve). :white_check_mark:
